review_text: This online clothing purchase was a complete disaster from start to finish. The dress I ordered looked nothing like the photos on the website. The color was completely different - I ordered navy blue but received something closer to black with a greenish tint. The fabric quality is absolutely terrible, feeling cheap and scratchy against the skin. It seems like it would fall apart after just one wash. The sizing is completely wrong despite following their size chart exactly. I ordered a medium based on their measurements, but what arrived was either an extra small or poorly cut. The stitching is uneven and sloppy with loose threads everywhere. Several seams were already coming apart right out of the package. The return process has been a nightmare. Their customer service is unresponsive and unhelpful. I've sent three emails over two weeks with no meaningful response, just automated replies. The return policy on their website is confusing and seems designed to discourage returns. They want me to pay for return shipping on a defective product, which is completely unreasonable. This company clearly doesn't care about customer satisfaction or product quality. I feel like I wasted my money and time dealing with this mess. Would never recommend this seller to anyone and will be leaving negative reviews everywhere possible to warn other potential customers.
